svg.aria-label: Jev answers in three shapes: a noul gives a yes-or-no as a probability, a choice picks one of your labels with a probability for each, and a score places the answer on a scale you described.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: You do not get a sentence. You get one of these three.
